nodes.npcLine: 🚸 Excuse me! I am lost. Could you give me directions to the bakery? Is it near here?
nodes.grammarCheck: Asking Directions & Imperative Guidance ('Go straight... Turn left...')

playerOptions.text: 🪧 Go straight along the street, turn left next to the crosswalk! The bakery is between the cafe and the town square.
🗺️ Open the City Map and go straight down Central Avenue!

nodes.npcLine: 🥐 Thank you! 'Go straight, turn left, next to the crosswalk, between the cafe and town square' — those are perfect directions!
nodes.grammarCheck: Prepositions of Place ('next to', 'behind', 'between') & Imperative Verbs

playerOptions.text: 🧭 You are welcome! Enjoy fresh baguettes at the bakery!

nodes.npcLine: 🗺️ The City Map is very helpful for navigating neighbourhood buildings! The post office is behind the pharmacy and the bakery is next to the square.

playerOptions.text: 📮 Walk to the post office and use the City Map!
